Onboarding.rules: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot or _

errors.characters: Use lowercase English letters, numbers, dots and _ only.

errors.extension: Can't end with a file extension like .png

CreatorPage.notFoundBody: This name is free. You can claim it for your Wsool page.
CreatorPage.hiddenTitle: This page isn't available right now
CreatorPage.hiddenBody: Its owner has hidden it for now.
CreatorPage.whatsappMessage: Hi, I found you through your Wsool page: {link}

EditPage.hidden: Hidden, only you can see it
EditPage.enEnabledHint: Shown to visitors whose device is in English. You write it yourself, no auto-translation.
EditPage.fixErrors: Fix the fields marked in red.

errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.needs_name: Add your name and save before publishing.

EditPage.photoHint: A clear, square photo of your face. JPG or PNG up to 8 MB.

uploadErrors.size: The file is larger than allowed.
uploadErrors.failed: We couldn't upload the file. Please try again.

EditPage.tagsHint: Short words under your bio, up to 18 characters each, max {max}.
EditPage.licensesHint: e.g. your Mawthooq license. Shown on your page only if you add one.
EditPage.licenseIncomplete: Each license needs a name and a number.

AccountsPage.accountsHint: Add your accounts and follower counts, up to {max}. The order here is the order on your page.
AccountsPage.rowError: Enter a valid username (English letters, numbers, . _ -) and the follower count.
AccountsPage.verificationWarning: This account is verified or in review. Saving this change removes the verification and you'll need to verify it again.
AccountsPage.savedReset: ✓ Changes saved. Accounts you changed are no longer verified; verify them again in Verification.
AccountsPage.monthlyViewsHint: Your total views across all platforms this month. Leave it empty to hide it.
AccountsPage.viewsHidden: The box is hidden on your page.
AccountsPage.audienceHint: Optional. When added, visitors can tap the platform card to see it. Copy the percentages from your account insights.
AccountsPage.audienceNoAccounts: Add and save an account first, then you can add its audience.
AccountsPage.over100: Each group's percentages must add up to 100% or less.

WorkPage.brandsHint: Upload brand logos and name each brand, up to {max}. They scroll across your page.
WorkPage.logoHint: PNG with a transparent background works best, or JPG/WebP, up to 4 MB. You can pick several at once.
WorkPage.worksHint: Portrait videos of your past ads, up to {max}. Visitors tap a work to watch it.
WorkPage.freeLimit: On the Free plan only your first {n} works show on your page. Put the best ones first.
WorkPage.videoHint: MP4 or MOV up to 50 MB. The cover is taken from the start of the video; you can change it.

RatesPage.showOnPageHint: When hidden, visitors see "Rates on request".
RatesPage.needAccounts: Add your accounts first, then you can set a rate for each platform.
RatesPage.rateIncomplete: Enter the ad type and price on every line.
RatesPage.bundlesHint: Optional. A bundle combines several platforms at one price. When the same ad type name exists on every platform in the bundle, visitors see "instead of" and the savings.
RatesPage.bundleNeedsTwo: You need at least two accounts to make a bundle.
RatesPage.noComparison: No comparison: the same name must exist on every chosen platform.
RatesPage.bundleIncomplete: Each bundle needs at least two platforms, and an ad type and price on every line.

ContactPage.intro: Brands contact you from your page with one tap. Leave a field empty to hide it.
ContactPage.whatsappHint: With the country code, e.g. <num>+966 50 123 4567</num>. A Saudi number starting with 05 gets <num>+966</num> added automatically.
ContactPage.whatsappInvalid: That number isn't valid. Include the country code.
ContactPage.emailHint: Can be different from your Wsool account email.
ContactPage.noneWarning: No contact method. Brands won't be able to reach you from your page.

AppearancePage.templateLocked: This template is for Pro subscribers. On the Free plan you can use White or Black.
AppearancePage.proOnly: This option is for Pro subscribers.
AppearancePage.customHint: We derive the rest of the palette from your colors and adjust them slightly when needed so text stays readable.
AppearancePage.accentHint: Used for your specialty, the WhatsApp button and highlights. Very light colors are darkened a bit so they stay readable.
AppearancePage.hideBranding: Hide "Made with ❤️ on Wsool" on my page
AppearancePage.previewCaption: Approximate preview. Save to update your page.

Suspended.title: Your account is suspended
Suspended.body: The Wsool team has suspended your account and your page is hidden from visitors. Your data is kept and nothing was deleted. To ask why or appeal, contact us.

VerificationPage.how1: Open your profile in the app and take a screenshot showing the username and follower count.
VerificationPage.how2: Upload it here without editing. The numbers must match what you entered in Accounts.
VerificationPage.how3: Our team reviews it within 48 hours. Verification lasts 90 days, and we remind you a week before it ends.
VerificationPage.noAccounts: Add your accounts first to verify them.
VerificationPage.freeNote: The verified badge shows on your page with Pro. You can verify now; the badge appears when you subscribe.
VerificationPage.expiresIn: Verification ends in {days} days ({date}). Renew it to keep the badge.
VerificationPage.expiredNote: Verification has expired. Upload a new screenshot to verify again.
VerificationPage.pendingNote: We got your screenshot and will review it within {hours} hours.
VerificationPage.renewalPending: Renewal in review (within {hours} hours). The badge stays until then.

reasons.username_missing: The username isn't visible in the screenshot.
reasons.followers_mismatch: The follower count in the screenshot doesn't match the number you entered.
reasons.unclear: The screenshot is unclear or cropped.
reasons.not_owner: We couldn't confirm the account is yours.
reasons.other_account: The screenshot shows a different account.

checks.username: The username in the screenshot matches the account
checks.followers: The follower count matches the number entered
checks.authentic: The screenshot is genuine, recent and unedited

verifications.viewOnly: View only: you can't decide on requests.

delete.deleteHint: Your page disappears right away and renewal stops. You have 30 days to undo; after that everything is deleted for good and your username becomes available.

Analytics.direct: All visits were direct (copied link or an app).
Analytics.emptyBody: Share your link {link} in your bio and replies to brands, and the numbers will show up here.
Analytics.privacy: We don't store any personal data about visitors. Your own visits while signed in aren't counted.
Analytics.lockedBody: See how many people visited your page, from which countries, and how many tapped WhatsApp or email. We collect the numbers already; you'll see them once you subscribe.

Notify.footer: You got this email because you have a Wsool account. Manage reminder emails under Notifications in your dashboard.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Wsool 👋
welcome.title: Your page is ready to build
welcome.body:
Welcome! Your account is ready, with a free 14-day Pro trial, no card needed.
Add your photo, accounts and rates, then publish your page and share the link with brands.

trial_reminder.subject: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left on your Pro trial
trial_reminder.title: Your free trial ends soon
trial_reminder.body:
Your Pro trial ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({endDate}).
Subscribe to keep templates, the verified badge and analytics. If you don't, your page moves to Free and none of your data is deleted.

trial_ended.subject: Your Pro trial has ended
trial_ended.title: Your page is now on Free
trial_ended.body:
Your Pro trial has ended and your page is on the Free plan. All your data is kept.
Subscribe anytime to get every Pro feature back right away.

payment_receipt.subject: Payment received: invoice {invoice}
payment_receipt.title: Thanks, you're on Pro
payment_receipt.body:
We received {amount} (VAT included) for Wsool Pro.
Your plan is active until {periodEndDate} and renews automatically.

renewal_receipt.subject: Your plan renewed: invoice {invoice}
renewal_receipt.title: Pro renewed
renewal_receipt.body:
We renewed your plan for {amount} (VAT included).
Your plan is active until {periodEndDate}.

renewal_upcoming.subject: Your yearly plan renews soon
renewal_upcoming.title: Renewal reminder
renewal_upcoming.body:
Your Pro plan renews automatically on {renewDate} for {amount}.
If you don't want to renew, turn off auto-renew on the Subscription page before then.

payment_failed.subject: We couldn't renew your plan
payment_failed.title: Renewal payment failed
payment_failed.body:
We tried to renew Pro for {amount} and the payment didn't go through.
We'll try again on {retryDate}. You can pay now with another card so your plan doesn't stop.

subscription_ended.subject: Your Pro plan has ended
subscription_ended.title: Your page is back on Free
subscription_ended.body:
Your Pro plan has ended and your page is on the Free plan. All your data is kept.
You can subscribe again anytime.

refund_issued.subject: Refund for invoice {invoice}
refund_issued.title: Refund issued
refund_issued.body:
We refunded {amount} for invoice {invoice}. Your bank may take a few days to show it.
Your Pro plan has ended and your page is on Free.

verification_approved.subject: ✓ Your {platform} account is verified
verification_approved.title: Your account is verified
verification_approved.body:
We verified {handle} on {platform}, and the badge now shows on your page.
Verification is valid until {untilDate}; we'll remind you a week before.

verification_rejected.subject: We couldn't verify your {platform} account
verification_rejected.title: Verification request rejected
verification_rejected.body:
We reviewed your screenshot of {handle} on {platform} and couldn't verify it: {reason}
Upload a new screenshot and we'll review it again.

verification_expiring.subject: Your {platform} verification ends in a week
verification_expiring.title: Renew your verification
verification_expiring.body:
Verification of {handle} on {platform} ends on {untilDate}.
Upload a recent screenshot to keep the badge on your page.

verification_expired.subject: Your {platform} verification has expired
verification_expired.title: Verification expired
verification_expired.body:
Verification of {handle} on {platform} has expired and the badge was removed from your page.
Upload a recent screenshot to verify it again.

deletion_scheduled.subject: Your account will be deleted on {purgeDate}
deletion_scheduled.title: You asked to delete your account
deletion_scheduled.body:
Your page is hidden, and your account and all data will be deleted for good on {purgeDate}.
Changed your mind? Sign in and tap "Undo deletion" before then.

team_invite.subject: You're invited to the Wsool team
team_invite.title: You joined the Wsool team
team_invite.body:
You were added to the Wsool team as "{role}".
Sign in with your email ({email}), then open wsool.link/admin.
team_invite.footer: You got this email because the Wsool owner added you to the team. If this means nothing to you, ignore it.

Notifications.remindersHint: Before your trial ends and before a verification expires.
Notifications.productNewsHint: New features and tips for working with brands, at most once a month.
Notifications.alwaysSent: Account, billing and verification emails are always sent.
